title: A mixed loan chargeback credits the FUND_SOURCE 350.00, then debits OVERPAYMENT 250.00, then debits LOAN_PORTFOLIO 100.00 (loan 21 L109)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the THREE-LEG journal entry a loan CHARGEBACK posted on a loan that is NOT charged off, the mixed shape, on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, product LP1 / product 6) at the chargeback transaction. request.chargeback_journal.amount is the accepted chargeback request transactionAmount 350.0 -> "35000" minor units, raised with paymentTypeId 2 (loans/loan-21/loan-21-chargeback-request.json); transaction_id L109 is the journal entries' transaction id for the read-back's transaction id 109 (type loanTransactionType.chargeback, which follows a 500.00 repayment carrying a 250.00 overpayment and 250.00 principal). request.chargeback_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's chargeback transaction id 109 after the chargeback: principalPortion 100.0 -> "10000", overpaymentPortion 250.0 -> "25000"; the observed identity amount = principal + overpayment holds exactly (35000 = 10000 + 25000). request.chargeback_journal.accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping read back from the accepted create request product-mappings/create-request-LP1.json: fundSourceAccountId 4, loanPortfolioAccountId 10, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 18; paymentTypeId 2 has no channel mapping, so the default FUND_SOURCE 4 applies. expect.chargeback_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the three L109 legs in id order: JE 240 CREDIT account 4 350.0, JE 241 DEBIT account 18 250.0, JE 242 DEBIT account 10 100.0. THIS VECTOR GRADES ONE PROPERTY: a chargeback credits the amount to the resolved fund source, then debits the OVERPAYMENT portion to OVERPAYMENT, then debits the principal credited beyond paid to LOAN_PORTFOLIO, in that posting order -- the overpayment debit PRECEDES the principal debit. It is the shape that discriminates both the registered drive loan-wrong-chargeback-journal-overpayment-to-portfolio (a port that routes the overpayment portion to LOAN_PORTFOLIO moves the debit from account 18 to account 10) and a port that reorders the two debits. Nothing was computed by this promotion: every amount, every account and every expected leg is read directly from the committed files.
